title: Modular architecture
decisions: Start as a modular monolith and extract services only when metrics justify it.
Organize modules by business capability, not by global technical type.
Domain does not depend on Application, Infrastructure, or the HTTP layer.
Application depends on Domain and declares ports for external effects.
Infrastructure implements ports without leaking details into Domain.
Endpoints validate the protocol and delegate to use cases.
forbidden: Business rules inside controllers or React components
A database shared directly between modules without an application contract
